## CalendarResourceClient.get() method

Read the calendar identified by `id`<!-- -->. When several calendars share the same name, the first match in the app's order is used, and the operation does not fail as ambiguous.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get(id: string, options?: CallOptions): Promise<Calendar>;
```
